name: spillout
description: Privacy-first communication platform with end-to-end encrypted messaging and encrypted voice calls

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
